title: Serke
description:
Serke is a hack and slash game where you fight against a virus invasion.
Use 5 different weapons to defeat your enemies and save the virtual world.

Cyanea
 Cyanea is a one-handed sword weapon with excellent mobility.
 It is a well-balanced weapon with all abilities satisfactory.

Spinifer
 Spinifer summons drones and turrets based on his rifle to constantly move and fight.
 It is a weapon that can attack the enemy unilaterally from a distance.

Red clawed
 Red clawed is a large halberd-shaped melee weapon.
 Crush your enemies in one blow with powerful damage.

Imperator
 Imperator is a powerful ranged weapon that uses firepower equipment.
 Destroy enemies using high-power equipment such as shotguns, gatling, laser cannons, and grenades.

Death stolker
 Death stolker is a close-quarters fighting weapon.
 Because you attack with kicks and punches, you can have a fast-paced battle.
